hook.title: One example beats ten *adjectives*
hook.sub: the fastest way to get the style you want

scenes.before: write a catchy, fun, punchy, modern product description for my desk lamp
scenes.after:
Here are two product descriptions I like:
1. [paste]

scenes.title: Describe it vs *show* it
Adjectives are *vague*
scenes.body: "Punchy" means something different to everyone. Including the AI.

scenes.title: Examples are *specific*
scenes.body: Length, tone, rhythm, structure. It copies all of it at once.

end.title: Try it on your next *prompt*
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
Stacking adjectives ("catchy, fun, punchy, modern") is the slowest way to get the style you want.

Paste one or two examples you like and say "same style and length". The AI picks up tone, rhythm and structure from the examples in a way no adjective can describe.

Works for emails, captions, code style, anything.
